reason: The facts establish a transfer of possession (partition) after the statutory date. However, the statutory ground under Section 14(1)(b) requires 'consent in writing' (LAW:1134266:p0004.s005). The record only shows the father's verbal permission/establishment of the business (p0002.s002@0:412). Per the strict interpretation in RC-03 and RC-01, verbal permission or general family permission does not satisfy the 'written consent' requirement. The absence of a written consent document in the record means the substantive ground is not established by the supplied materials.

evidence.quote: On January 12, 1965 he applied for ejectment... under proviso (b) to Sub-section (i) of Section 14 of the Delhi Rent Control Act, 1958.
The application alleged that the first appellant has sub-let, assigned or otherwise parted with a part of the shop to the other appellants.
The Rent Controller accordingly held that the plea of joint business has not established. Dr. Vijay Kumar And Ors. vs Raghbir Singh Anokh Singh on 22 May, 1973
